statements.label: eq. (1)-(2)
statements.restatement: grad C(x + t kappa) = grad C(x) + t H_kappa x; ker H_kappa = span of the 16 single-entry vectors (dim 10), rank H_kappa = 4.

statements.label: Lemma 1
statements.restatement: If the height line x + C kappa lies in X and Pc(x) >= 0, then c(x) = sum a_ij n_ij is a single-entry cost and Phi_c(x)(O) = sum a_ij O_ij^2 >= 0 (Birkhoff).

statements.label: Lemma 2
statements.restatement: On an irreducible affine curve with regular g_j, not all constant, Re sum g_j = 1, c real-linear in Re g, K closed convex: if c in K wherever all Re g_j >= 0 with one zero, then c in K wherever all Re g_j > 0.

statements.label: Theorem 3
statements.restatement: If c(x) in K for all x in X with Pc(x) >= 0 and at least six zeros, then c(x) in K for all x in X with Pc(x) >= 0.

statements.label: Theorem 4
statements.restatement: For fixed O_0 in SO(4): a feasible x with Phi_c(x)(O_0) < 0 yields a feasible x' with at least six contacts (old ones kept) and Phi_c(x')(O_0) < 0.
